title: Persist markdown wrap toggle per buffer for current Neovim session
description: Fix markdown wrap behavior so the user toggle persists for the toggled buffer/window state during the current Neovim session instead of being reset by BufWinEnter defaults.

comments.author: Kirby Little
comments.text: Implemented markdown wrap persistence for the current Neovim session by storing a markdown buffer-local wrap preference and reapplying it on BufWinEnter. Updated keymap behavior at <leader>uw to persist markdown buffers while leaving non-markdown buffers window-local.

comments.author: Kirby Little
comments.text: Follow-up fix: the first implementation depended too much on a local <leader>uw override. Updated markdown wrap persistence to save the current wrap state on BufLeave/WinLeave and restore it on BufWinEnter, so any wrap toggle source persists across markdown buffer switches in-session.

comments.author: Kirby Little
comments.text: Removed the local <leader>uw override because the user's wrap toggle likely comes from upstream runtime config outside this repo. Persistence is now handled by markdown ftplugin + BufLeave/WinLeave + BufWinEnter state restore, so it works regardless of which mapping toggles wrap.

title: Persist wrap per buffer for all filetypes in Neovim session
description: Generalize the current wrap persistence behavior so window-local wrap is remembered per buffer across buffer/window switches for all filetypes during the current Neovim session, while preserving markdown default wrap=false behavior.

comments.author: Kirby Little
comments.text: Generalized wrap persistence from markdown-only to all buffers by storing window-local wrap in a generic buffer var on BufLeave/WinLeave and restoring it on BufWinEnter. Markdown ftplugin still initializes its default to wrap=false by seeding the same generic buffer var.

title: Survey Obsidian.nvim and Obsidian CLI builtin capabilities for chezmoi Neovim config
description: Review current custom obsidian.nvim behavior against the latest upstream changelog and produce a markdown report covering where builtins or Obsidian CLI commands can replace or improve custom commands/functions.

comments.author: Kirby Little
comments.text: Added docs/OBSIDIAN_NVIM_CLI_SURVEY.md surveying current custom obsidian.nvim behavior against current upstream obsidian.nvim capabilities and the official Obsidian CLI, with recommendations on what to replace, keep thin, or keep custom.

value: NEVER edit files in ~/.config/* directly - always edit in ~/.local/share/chezmoi/. Changes to ~/.config are overwritten by chezmoi apply.
